name: stock-trader-skills
description: Claude skills for stock traders, built on free data. An investment committee that argues the bull, bear and risk case and writes a one-page HTML report. Stock screener, market regime and economic calendar, 13F fund holdings, insider and Congress trades, fundamentals checked against SEC filings, technical analysis with backtests, company history, news, scenarios with a scorecard, and a portfolio journal with pre-trade risk checks. No API keys. Does not place trades. Not investment advice.
